question_text: In the past week, how much of your day has been taken up by unwanted intrusive thoughts? How often do they appear?
answer_space: E = Nearly constant; >8 hours/day; intrusive throughout the day

question_text: How much do these intrusive thoughts interfere with your work, school, or social functioning?
answer_space: B = Mild; noticeable but does not impair tasks
C = Moderate interference; activities harder but still manageable
E = Severe; unable to function socially or occupationally

question_text: When these thoughts appear, how distressing or upsetting are they for you?
answer_space: C = Moderate; distress present but controllable

question_text: When these thoughts come up, how often do you try to resist or push them away?
answer_space: A = Always attempts resistance / symptoms too mild to resist
E = No resistance; fully accepts the intrusive thoughts

question_text: How much control do you feel you have over stopping or shifting away from these thoughts?
answer_space: B = Mostly able to control with effort
D = Very little control; attempts rarely work
E = No control at all; thoughts occur involuntarily

question_text: During the past week, how much time have you spent performing compulsive behaviors or rituals?
answer_space: B = <1 hour/day or occurs only occasionally
C = 1–3 hours/day or frequent (>8 times/day but not constant)
D = 3–8 hours/day or very frequent (>8 times/day and occupying most periods)

question_text: How much do these behaviors interfere with your social life, daily tasks, or work?
answer_space: B = Mild; noticeable but activities maintained
C = Moderate; clear interference but manageable

question_text: If you're stopped from performing a compulsion, how anxious or uncomfortable do you become?
answer_space: E = Extreme; distress intolerable, highly agitated

question_text: How much do you try to resist or avoid performing compulsive behaviors?
answer_space: A = Always attempts to resist / symptoms low
D = Rare resistance; performs rituals with reluctance
E = No resistance; willingly performs all rituals

question_text: How much control do you feel you have over stopping or delaying the compulsive behaviors?
answer_space: B = Mostly can control with effort
C = Partial control; strong drive but can delay
